resources.string: Display mode per app, automatic switching, contrast, ghosting
The E-ink service is not running. These settings are not available.
Choose smooth or clear rendering on the E-ink for each app, and more options

The E-ink offers two display modes. Smooth mode refreshes faster but the picture is weaker. Clear mode gives a cleaner picture but refreshes more slowly; it suits reading apps. The switch changes the mode; tap an app for more options. Changes apply at once if the app is on the E-ink. The Quick Settings tile \"E-ink: clear/smooth\" switches the app in front.
Contrast, black and white thresholds, clear ghosting
Values from 0 to 100. A change is applied when you release the slider, and takes effect on the E-ink when it is in use.
Redraws the whole E-ink once to remove traces of earlier pictures. Works only while the E-ink is in use.

While a finger drags on the screen, the E-ink switches to smooth mode; shortly after the finger is lifted, the app\'s mode comes back. Useful for apps set to Clear. This only approximates the stock feature, which held the picture still during the drag, and may not help with some apps.
Smooth while the camera is in use

Applies to the app in front on the E-ink: smooth mode while it uses a camera, or while it plays video or game sound. Speech (for example read-aloud) and music do not count. The app\'s own mode comes back when it stops.
